headline: ODFL Q2 Deep Dive: Yield Discipline and Margin Gains Amid Volume Headwinds
summary: Freight carrier Old Dominion (NASDAQ:ODFL) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.4% year on year to $1.55 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.68 per share was 9.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
